scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.go: docker compose up -d db && sleep 4 && npm run import -- scripts/sample-profiles.csv && npm run dev
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && echo 'DB wiped. Run npm run go to start fresh.'
scripts.test:api: node --env-file=.env --test server/match-api.test.js && node --env-file=.env --test server/action-feedback-api.test.js && node --env-file=.env --test server/admin-api.test.js
scripts.test:all: node --test server/field-registry.test.js server/matching.test.js && npm run test:api && npm run test:auth && npm run test:email
